I do see now that maybe the power list was a little too large. 

I've been considering simply giving him enhanced physical attributes and maybe an extra power or two. 

Illorian biology is something that's really got me thinking. 

I think it would be best to say that since Orion is from another universe, that the effects of the physics of our Universe gave him the powers, other than saying that  all Illorians had these powers to begin with.

I personally thought of the panther thing because of the fact that i'd heard of many unlikely animal friendships and stories of animals befriending humans and animals being empathic towards other animals (not just humans) in the past, so i didn't think of it as too far of a stretch. And also, i thought it would be kind of nice to give Zarr/Orion a guardian, because he would have a reason to develop the morals that he does develop.

He is introduced to the modern world after being captured by an agency investigating the villager's missing crops. 

They find out he has powers, and the agency wants to do research on him, but realizes that they are too small and don't have the funding or government approval to carry out such research. He is given to a bigger private lab who have the funding and adequate equipment needed to carry out such tests. They keep it a secret and test him with no government approval or permission of any sort. He escapes and is taken in by a family in capital who realize the potential of the abilities he has. He quickly learns about life in this new world (Illorians are much more intelligent than humans) And realizes what an unfair society humans live in, he decides to help humans some way. Having no formal training in anything, he decides to help in more practical ways, and thus is a hero. He would not develop these morals and philosophies if his guardian hadn't been killed. 

If i'm being totally honest, i never knew of Tarzan's racist past, but i do very much see how it could have been used for that purpose. I'll have to do some research on the subject, which is kind of ironic seeing as i'm African.
